verdict.rationale: The firm's own offices page explicitly lists only seven U.S. offices (Boston, New York, San Francisco, Santa Monica, Seattle, Silicon Valley, Washington DC) with no international offices listed, and no evidence pack item describes a foreign branch office or formal cross-border affiliate practice. While trademark prosecution is claimed across 180+ jurisdictions, this reflects filing capability (likely via local agents) rather than the firm having its own offices or qualified practices abroad.
